system.description: The Dragon-Blood leads an army of his Chosen and mortal kin in battle. This Charm requires the Exalt to shout his defiance of those who stand against the cosmic order and call upon the Dragon-Blooded assembled among his troops; any Terrestrial Exalt with at least Breeding 3 who can hear his rallying cry and chooses to answer it may sacrifice himself as a Martyr to power the Charm. The Exalt spends 50 motes and five Willpower from the pool, with additional sacrificed Dragon-Bloods contributing their own Essence pool to the cost. (If not enough resources are available, the Charm simply fails.) At the Storyteller's discretion, the Dragon-Blood may further draw on the Essence of a dragon line on which his army stands or with which he has a strong elemental resonance. Once activated, all Dragon-Blood who sacrificed themselves to power the Charm and all those who survive the battle are resurrected whole one year and a day later, returned to life by the grace of the elemental Dragons in recognition of their sacrifice. The effect of the Charm is a massive elemental conflagration. The entire battlefield is shaken by earth tremors, scalded by geysers, scoured by hurricane winds, lashed by lightning or carpeted in blooms of thorn bushes, depending upon the aspect of the activating Dragon-Blood. All foes on the battlefield suffer (Essence x 3) levels of elemental damage (lethal for air, earth and wood; lethal, Obvious and incendiary for fire; bashing for water), minus their most applicable soak. Beings without an elemental aspect suffer double damage. The Dragon-Blood and all allied Dragon-Blooded are protected by their attunement to the element and instead receive a temporary pool of (Essence) motes that may be used only to protect against the elemental damage; Dragon-Bloods of the same aspect as the activating Dragon-Blood may also use these to fuel their own elemental effects triggered by the battle.
